problem_statement.description: Given an array of integers and a target value, identify two elements whose sum equals the target and return their indices.
problem_statement.input: An array of integers and a target value.
problem_statement.output: The indices of two elements whose sum equals the target.

expected_algorithm.approach: Use a hash map to store previously seen values and their indices.
steps: Check whether the complement has already been seen.
If found, return the stored index and current index.
Otherwise, store the current value and its index.

expected_reasoning_steps: If found, return the two indices.
Otherwise, store the current value and index.
Continue until a valid pair is found.
